event.description: St. Thomas-Minnesota Tommies @ South Dakota Coyotes

keywords: St. Thomas-Minnesota Tommies @ South Dakota Coyotes
article.story: VERMILLION, S.D. -- — Chase Forte's 30 points led South Dakota past St. Thomas 85-80 on Wednesday night. Forte also contributed nine rebounds and three steals for the Coyotes (17-11, 8-5 Summit League). Quandre Bullock scored 15 points while going 5 of 10 from the floor, including 1 for 6 from 3-point range, and 4 for 4 from the free-throw line. Max Burchill had 13 points and shot 3 for 8 (3 for 6 from 3-point range) and 4 of 4 from the free-throw line. Miles Barnstable finished with 16 points for the Tommies (20-8, 10-3). Carter Bjerke added 14 points for St. Thomas. Kendall Blue had 14 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
